title: Tenant-focused compliance snapshot packager with incremental deltas and gated delivery
creator: Asha Patel
description: Deliver a tenant-scoped compliance snapshot packager that generates bundled evidence exports in multiple formats (PDF, CSV, JSONL), supports incremental delta snapshots, verifies provenance with signed manifests, and schedules gated delivery to tenant-configured endpoints (HTTPS, SFTP, AWS S3 with VPC endpoints). Must respect tenant data residency and retention policies and provide proof-of-delivery and automated rehydration paths for audit requests.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can configure per-tenant export cadence (daily/weekly/monthly) and choose format(s) and destination endpoints in the Console.
Exports contain a signed manifest listing included objects with cryptographic hashes and the KMS-encrypted envelope keys when using envelope encryption.
Incremental export mode produces delta packages referencing the previous snapshot; full snapshots are optional and scheduled per tenant.
Delivery respects tenant residency routing: exports for EU-resident tenants remain in EU endpoints or use approved transfer methods.
Delivery attempts are retried with exponential backoff and each package produces a delivery receipt recorded in the Audit Ledger visible in Console UI.
Dashboard surfaces export health metrics: last-run, duration, size, failures, bytes transferred by region, and estimated billable units.
Admin can trigger on-demand rehydration for a date-range; system streams results as paginated CSV or zipped JSONL with same provenance manifest.
SLA: 99% of scheduled exports complete within configured window for Dedicated customers (documented in release notes).
All crypto operations use customer or Redwood KMS keys per tenant settings; security review sign-off obtained before GA.
work_breakdown: Engineering: delivery workers and backoff policy (ENG-4689)
Security: KMS/envelope integration and manifest signature review
Console: schedule UI, delivery endpoint builder, and dashboard widgets
QA: end-to-end tests with regional residency mocks and failure injection
Docs: admin guide and runbook for troubleshooting export failures
ux_notes: Design should make it clear which tenants have residency constraints and validate allowed destination types accordingly. Provide default templates for 'Audit-ready PDF' (human readable) and 'Machine CSV/JSONL' (for bulk ingestion). Include an export size estimate and cost impact preview prior to saving schedule.
api_contract_summary: POST /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/exports -> creates schedule. GET /v1/exports/{export_id}/manifest -> returns signed manifest (detached signature). Webhook/Delivery callbacks use standardized receipt schema. All responses include metadata headers for residency, encryption, and billing tags.
infra_requirements: Temporary workspace storage in same region as tenant residency for package assembly
Horizontal workers per-region with delivery throttling tied to capacity pool
Short-lived signed URLs for S3 delivery with region restriction enforcement
Audit ledger table with immutable append-only records and retention TTL configurable by tenant
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (internal beta): enable for 3 pilot tenants with varying residency settings (US, EU, APAC)
Phase 2 (closed beta): open to selected Dedicated customers, add cost-estimate on schedule UI
Phase 3 (GA): enable for all tenants with default throttling; require security_review_required flag cleared
Feature flag gating: exports.v1.enable per-tenant until GA
risks: Large tenants producing huge snapshots could exhaust regional ephemeral storage; mitigation: streaming assembly and size caps
Cross-region transfer may violate residency guarantees if misconfigured; mitigation: strict validation and telemetry alerts
KMS integration complexity when tenant-supplied keys are rotated; mitigation: rotation policies and key caching strategy
Delivery failure storms could overload retry queues; mitigation: circuit breaker and backpressure to scheduling UI
qa_test_cases: Create daily export for EU tenant that targets EU-only S3 endpoint; verify package built in EU and delivery success
Simulate partial failure on delivery to SFTP, assert retry attempts and final failed receipt recorded
Enable incremental mode, run three snapshots, verify that second and third snapshots contain only changed object IDs and maintain manifest chain
Trigger on-demand rehydration for historical window and confirm pagination, integrity hashes, and manifest signature
Verify cost-estimate shown on schedule UI matches bytes transferred in dashboard after run
updates: 2025-03-03 — Initial spec drafted by Asha Patel. High-level UX map attached to Confluence. Asked ENG to validate feasibility for regional assembly.
2025-03-05 — Engineering feasibility call: confirmed streaming assembly possible but requires per-region ephemeral storage quota increase. ENG assigned follow-up (ENG-4521).
2025-03-08 — Security flagged KMS envelope signature pattern; recommended detached signature format and explicit key-id in manifest. Marked security_review_required=true.
2025-03-11 — Design review with Leah Chen: consolidated export format presets and added cost preview. Mockups updated in Confluence. UX to validate wording for residency enforcement.
2025-03-12 — Changed scope: added incremental delta snapshot mode to reduce bandwidth and storage costs after pilot customer feedback. Updated acceptance criteria and QA matrix.
comments: Miguel Ramos (Engineering): We need to gate full-snapshot exports with a hard size cap until streaming assembly lands. I'll open an infra ticket for quota adjustments.
Priya Singh (Security): For tenants with customer-managed keys we must document the key access pattern and fallbacks if keys are disabled. Add rotation test cases.
Leah Chen (Design): UX should default to machine-readable CSV+JSONL for programmatic tenants and human PDF for auditors; allow multi-select.
Customer Success (note): Several customers requested signed receipts that include the export checksum; include this in manifest and delivery receipt.
